# WiredTiger spill instance cache — facts

> Source-anchored units about WiredTiger spill instance cache: 13 across 4 sources. Each line ends in the URL and anchor it came from; `keywords:` names the lexicon terms that matched.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-30 · 13 units · 4 sources · rights: quote -->

## How it works

- [statement] serverStatus.spillWiredTiger.cache reports capacity, occupancy, dirty bytes, dirty-trigger occurrences and application-thread eviction time. A useful derived diagnostic is dirty bytes divided by that spill cache's maximum configured bytes; this ratio is an analytical calculation, not a separately documented field. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus.md · keywords: WiredTiger spill instance cache

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] The inspected master declarations default spill cache sizing to 2.5% of system memory, bounded by 100 MB and 1000 MB; getSpillCacheSizeMB truncates the percentage result and clamps it to the bounds. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/storage/wiredtiger/wiredtiger_global_options.idl · keywords: WiredTiger spill instance cache · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/storage/wiredtiger/wiredtiger_util.cpp
- [statement] The inspected master spill defaults are 5% dirty target, 80% dirty trigger and 80% updates trigger, with one eviction worker; these are spill-engine settings. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/storage/wiredtiger/wiredtiger_global_options.idl · keywords: WiredTiger spill instance cache · also: https://github.com/moghtech/komodo/issues/1320
- [statement] The Komodo report's April 3, 2026 startup logs show a 256M main cache and a separate 498M spill cache, with 24MB dirty target and 398MB dirty trigger; this illustrates why main-cache size alone does not bound both caches. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-04-03) — https://github.com/moghtech/komodo/issues/1320 · keywords: WiredTiger spill instance cache · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus.md, https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.2/src/mongo/db/storage/wiredtiger/spill_wiredtiger_kv_engine.cpp
- [statement] MongoDB v8.2 spill dirty-eviction target defaults to 5%; dirty trigger and updates trigger default to 80%. Startup configuration converts these percentages to MB using the spill cache capacity. The dirty trigger description identifies application-thread eviction. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.2/src/mongo/db/storage/wiredtiger/wiredtiger_global_options.idl · keywords: WiredTiger spill instance cache · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.2/src/mongo/db/storage/wiredtiger/spill_wiredtiger_kv_engine.cpp

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The spill instance has a separate in-memory cache that isolates supported spilling operations from the main WiredTiger cache; serverStatus reports it under spillWiredTiger. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus.md · keywords: WiredTiger spill instance cache · also: https://github.com/moghtech/komodo/issues/1320
- [statement] SERVER-108184 documents startup initialization and memory overhead even without spilling queries; its lazy-initialization proposal was closed Won't Do on July 29, 2025. Cache isolation therefore should not be interpreted as zero additional memory overhead. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2025-07-29) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-108184 · keywords: WiredTiger spill instance cache · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-108257
- [statement] SERVER-108257 attributes meaningful memory overhead to the former 33000-session default and lists fixes in 8.2.0-rc1 and 8.3.0-rc0; inspected master declares a spill session maximum of 1024. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-108257 · keywords: WiredTiger spill instance cache · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/storage/wiredtiger/wiredtiger_global_options.idl
- [statement] WeKan reports a MongoDB 8.2.2 startup loop after disk exhaustion: spill-directory cleanup failed and the subsequent spill-instance open reported a missing version file. This is an incident about temporary storage initialization, not evidence that a dirty-cache threshold caused the crash. (low confidence) — https://tvwatch.su/wekan/wekan-gantt-gpl/blob/main/docs/Databases/MongoDB/Storage-Requirements.md · keywords: WiredTiger spill instance cache
- [statement] MongoDB documents a separate in-memory WiredTiger spill cache that isolates spill operations from the main cache. The v8.2 spill configuration computes its capacity through getSpillCacheSizeMB(). (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus.md · keywords: WiredTiger spill instance cache · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.2/src/mongo/db/storage/wiredtiger/spill_wiredtiger_kv_engine.cpp
- [statement] In MongoDB v8.2, spillWiredTigerCacheSizePercentage defaults to 2.5, bounded by spillWiredTigerCacheSizeMinMB=100 and spillWiredTigerCacheSizeMaxMB=1000. These are startup parameters; the spill configuration passes them to its sizing function. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.2/src/mongo/db/storage/wiredtiger/wiredtiger_global_options.idl · keywords: WiredTiger spill instance cache · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.2/src/mongo/db/storage/wiredtiger/spill_wiredtiger_kv_engine.cpp
- [statement] The inspected sizing function returns clamp(int32(systemMemoryMB * percentage * 0.01), minMB, maxMB), and rejects minMB greater than maxMB. Thus percentage=0 still yields the configured minimum; it does not disable the cache. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/storage/wiredtiger/wiredtiger_util.cpp · keywords: WiredTiger spill instance cache · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.2/src/mongo/db/storage/wiredtiger/wiredtiger_global_options.idl
- [statement] MongoDB v8.2 defines both spill eviction worker minimum and maximum as one thread by default, with startup-only controls. Its spill configuration takes these dedicated settings. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.2/src/mongo/db/storage/wiredtiger/wiredtiger_global_options.idl · keywords: WiredTiger spill instance cache · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.2/src/mongo/db/storage/wiredtiger/spill_wiredtiger_kv_engine.cpp
